name: idle-compact-warning
description: Sends a desktop notification before Claude Code's idle compaction, so you can come back while the full context is still there.

notifyUrl.title: Notify URL
notifyUrl.description: An HTTP endpoint that shows a notification; title and message are added as query parameters.

minutes.title: Warn after (minutes)
minutes.description: How long a large session sits idle before the warning. Idle compaction happens at about 54.
